message: I will never fly this airlines again... spent 3 1/2 hours standing in line in the Cancun Airport. Then they tell us that all the flights are delayed so we waited for another two hours. When we finally got on board the plane it was a pig pen and our seats were all the way in the back of the plane where we had to listen to the flight attendents complain about how tired they were. One of the attendants actually fell asleep! All I can say is, been there done that. Never again!
